speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. To start, can you describe the appearance and distribution of this longstanding pruritic rash on your palms? Also, on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate the intensity of the numbness and tingling?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (specifically Visceral Leishmaniasis with cutaneous involvement or Kala-azar presenting with neuropathy).

Based on your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, along with your year-long itchy rash on the upper body and face and numbness in your palms, I suspect an infection transmitted by sandflies. To confirm this, please undergo a bone marrow aspirate and blood smear for Leishmania amastigotes, and a complete blood count to check for anemia and low white blood cell counts. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Aspirate, Blood_Smear, CBC.
